column20: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2026-2027 Imagine travel trailers. The installed safety chains are underrated for the Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR).
column21: Underrated chains can allow the trailer to detach from the tow vehicle, increasing the risk of a crash.
column22: Dealers will replace the safety chains, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 19, 2026. Owners may contact Grand Design customer service at 1-574-825-9679. Grand Design's number for this recall is 910069.

column20: Temsa is recalling certain 2024-2025 TS35 coaches. The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.
column21: A fuel leak in the presence of an ignition source increases the risk of a fire. An engine stall increases the risk of a crash.
column22: Cummins dealers will replace the fuel hoses, free of charge.  Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 19, 2026. Owners may contact Cummins customer service at 1-800-286-6467 or Temsa customer service at 1-833-628-3672.

column20: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) modules with part number EB5Z-2C219-B, DB5Z-2C219-B, CB5Z-2C219-C, DL1Z-2C219-A, or DT4Z-2C219-B. The replacement ABS module may be programmed with the incorrect software, preventing the ABS from functioning as intended.
column21: An incorrectly programmed ABS may cause a loss of ABS and degrade brake balance, increasing the distance needed to stop and the risk of a crash.
column22: Dealers will inspect and replace the ABS module as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed November 30, 2026. Owners may contact Ford customer service at 1-866-436-7332. Ford's number for this recall is 26S76.
column26: Anti-Lock Brake System (ABS) service module for certain Ford Expedition, Explorer, and Edge vehicles and Lincoln Navigator and MKX vehicles.

column20: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2023–2027 Cadillac LYRIQ, 2025–2026 model year Cadillac CELESTIQ, 2024–2027 Chevrolet Blazer EV, and 2026-2027 Cadillac VISTIQ vehicles. The brake system control module (BSCM) contains a software defect that may cause a loss of braking during certain driving conditions.
column21: A loss of braking ability increases the risk of a crash.
column22: The BSCM software will be updated through an over-the-air (OTA) update or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Cadillac customer service at 1-800-333-4223 or Chevrolet customer service at 1-800-222-1020. GM's number for this recall is N262570900. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall became searchable on NHTSA.gov on October 29, 2026.

column20: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Acura TLX, 2022-2024 Acura MDX, and 2023-2025 Pilot vehicles. The software for the electric power steering (EPS) assist may cause the EPS system to enter a failsafe mode, resulting in a loss of power steering assist.
column21: A loss of power steering assist can increase the risk of a crash or injury.
column22: Dealers will reprogram the EPS control unit, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Honda's customer service at 1-866-784-1870. Honda's numbers for this recall are KQB and TQA. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning November 11, 2026.

column20: Michelin North America, Inc. (Michelin) is recalling certain Pilot Alpin 5 winter tires, size 235/55R19 105 H XL for sport utility vehicles (SUV). The DOT certification symbol is missing from the tire sidewalls. As such, these tires fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 139, "New Pneumatic Radial Tires for Light Vehicles."
column21: Tires that are missing a DOT symbol may be used in inappropriate applications, increasing the risk of a crash.
column22: Michelin will inspect and replace the tires, as necessary, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 26, 2026. Owners may contact Michelin's customer service at 1-888-971-3801.

column20: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2027 i7 50xDrive, i7 60xDrive, 2026-2027 i5 xDrive40, i5 eDrive40, and i5 M60 vehicles. The high voltage battery charging software may be incorrect.
column21: Software that does not charge the battery properly can lead to electric shock, increasing the risk of injury.
column22: Dealers will update the high voltage battery charging software, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 25, 2026. Owners may contact BMW customer service at 1-800-525-7417. Vehicle Identification Numbers (VINs) involved in this recall will be searchable on NHTSA.gov beginning December 25, 2026.

column20: Acura (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 Acura ZDX vehicles equipped with all-wheel drive. A software error may unexpectedly activate the anti-lock brake system (ABS) and release brake pressure.
column21: A loss of brake pressure may reduce braking ability, extending the distance needed to stop and increasing the risk of a crash.
column22: The electronic brake control module software will be updated over-the-air (OTA) or by a dealer, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 14, 2026. Owners may contact Acura customer service at 1-800-382-2238. Acura's number for this recall is CQC. This recall expands previous NHTSA recall number 24V614.

column20: Rosenbauer America (Rosenbauer) is recalling certain 2021-2026 Commander, Warrior, and 2021, 2024-2025 Avenger emergency vehicles equipped with a Bussmann mini fuse box. The fuse box may not have the correct amperage capacity, causing it to overheat.
column21: An overheated fuse box can melt, increasing the risk of a fire.
column22: Dealers will reroute large amp draws to a separate fuse bank, free of charge. Owner notification letters are expected to be mailed December 9, 2026. Owners may contact Rosenbauer customer service at 1-651-462-1000.
